messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: scheduled-drain-test triggered in us-west1 (low). Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/drain-test — please acknowledge in #incidents.
oncall-alex: ack — seeing alert. Is this our planned preflight or a mis-timed job?
sre-raj: quick check — controlplane shows a node reboot started ~5m early from the maintenance batch. KV cache evictions spiked briefly. No persistent state issues so far.
support-emma: FYI we have 3 live tickets referencing timeouts for embeddings since ~10:12 PST.
oncall-alex: thanks. pausing the remaining batch on the fleet. i'll reroute traffic away from the rebooting hosts and enable spillover to us-west2. will prepare a short statuspage blurb.
pm-jordan: can you drop a customer-facing sentence we can send to affected accounts? keep it simple + non-technical.
oncall-alex: Draft statuspage update (posting for review):
```
Incident: Elevated error rate for embedding requests in us-west1
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some embedding requests may see timeouts or 5xx errors. We are routing traffic to healthy nodes and pausing the maintenance batch to stabilize service. No data loss expected.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when mitigation completes.
```
support-emma: looks good. customer blurb for emails/Ticket reply:
```
Hi — we're investigating intermittent timeouts for embedding requests in US‑West. We've paused the maintenance batch and routed traffic to healthy capacity. We expect normal service shortly; we'll follow up once resolved. Sorry for the disruption.
```
eng-ops-lina: i'll take the on-call handoff at 1739014200. set a reminder and i'll continue mitigation if any residual errors show up.
oncall-alex: thanks @eng-ops-lina — statuspage patched and publish triggered. incident-bot should post the update.
incident-bot: Status page updated: "Elevated error rate for embedding requests in us-west1 — Investigating" :white_check_mark:
sre-raj: reroute applied, error rate dropped to baseline within ~6 minutes. KV cache warmup ongoing but requests returning normally.
oncall-alex: mitigation successful. rolling window resumed but with strict gating and manual approval per batch. i'll close the page after one final verification pass.
support-emma: customer follow-ups sent to the 3 impacted accounts. they acknowledged — no escalation.
oncall-alex: final: all systems stable, maintenance batch rescheduled to 02:00 UTC with explicit throttling. closing the incident thread. :team-heart:
eng-ops-lina: noted handoff complete. filing short post-incident note to ops-runbook and flagging the mis-timed job for deployment team review.
